doubao.scope: Installed Doubao IME 1.0.2 static keyboard/voice lexicon bridge; no execution or private profile access. DBL IDs are ordinary byte-verified LLVM observations, not REA IDs.
limits: Static reachability does not establish active settings, runtime receiver or recognition benefit.
Selected intervals can include adjacent helpers and undecoded atomic instructions.
Full filter policy, all account gates and offline-model hotword consumer remain incomplete.

limitations: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
References cover the complete Ghidra function-body AddressSet and exact entry. Dossier incoming edges omit sources owned by that function; procedure_references also retains those internal edges.
The dossier combines Ghidra FunctionManager, Listing, ReferenceManager, BasicBlockModel, and decompiler observations; provider-specific pseudocode and assembly are not cross-provider text invariants.

Resolved reference metadata identifies computed, indirect, external, call, jump, and data edges; unresolved targetless flows remain unknown, and function classifications distinguish thunks and externals.
Synthetic Ghidra entry-point references without actionable memory sources are omitted.
The Java bridge serializes one function request per Program and lets each decompilation run until it completes or the caller cancels.

chatterfly.scope: Shipped package bytes only; no execution, private profile data, settings, account state or network traffic accessed.
limitations: CF108 identifiers are local static observation IDs, not REA Evidence IDs.
REA inventory/extraction IDs from earlier 1.0.6 artifact must not authenticate current 1.0.8 bytes.
No successful native REA pseudocode dossier was available for Chatterfly; the prior Ghidra request timed out.
Static calls establish a possible shipped path, not enabled current settings, observed inference, server acceptance, retention or model training.
No wholesale base typing dictionary to speech dictionary copy was established; learned text and manually managed account terms have distinct paths.

findings.claim: A registered commit-text callback appends text to input-history collector. Collector flushes app-tagged committed text into store. Enhanced-recognition flag gates per-app cached history retrieval. ASR params builder serializes records with text, timestamp, app_name; ASR config supplies context_hist. Payload JSON UTF-8 over 6000 bytes causes context_hist to be removed.

findings.confidence: high for client cache build and typing consumption; server behavior unknown
findings.claim: TriggerVoiceDictBuildSync requests logical account lexicon term sync endpoint with Authorization and delta/since support. BuildVoiceUsrDict parses response into VoiceTermRecords, builds/saves dictionary type 0x9e. Typing candidate loader AddVoiceUsrEntry reads same 0x9e VoiceUsrDict and its words. Thus this build function supplies personal voice/account terms to keyboard candidates; its name does not prove typing dictionary upload to ASR.
ybvds_shouldSync compares elapsed time since voice_dict_sync_time against literal double 14400 seconds. Actual timer trigger execution was not observed.
